text:
alex: Quick heads-up — local eval runner crashes when bringing up quantized Llama variant if config sets `prefix_cache: true` and `batching.strategy: auto`. Repro on my Mac and in CI. Logs below.

alex: config snippet:
```
model:
  name: gptq-llama-7b
  quantize: true
  prefix_cache: true
batching:
  strategy: auto
  target_tokens: 2048
```

alex: error:
```
RuntimeError: kv-cache mismatch: expected 128, got 64
  at serving/runtime/session.py:482
  at runner/batcher.py:93
```

maria: cc @sam can you take a quick look? sounds like the batching heuristics assume fp32 sequence layouts

sam: I'll repro. do you have the exact command you ran?

alex: `./evalharness run --config ./tests/repros/quant-kv.yml --mode local --dry-run false`

devex-bot: CI failure notice — pipeline `evalharness-local` failed on job `quantized:runner` (link: https://ci.internal/1234)

qa-junior: This popped up in nightly too — it flipped a regression alert on the dashboard (metric: token-error-rate). We might need a test that covers quantized + prefix cache.

maria: If batching.strategy==auto we pick a smaller kv-block for quantized models to save memory; bug is we don't resize the prefix cache windows. Quick fix: add validation that `prefix_cache` and `batching.strategy:auto` combine to an allowed tuple or force `batching.strategy: fixed`.

sam: I have a small repro patch, will open PR. Also adding an integration CI job: `quantized-persistency-e2e` that runs tiny prompts against quantized models with prefix cache on. avoids full long-run.

alex: thank you. Can we also surface a CLI lint warning? e.g. `evalctl lint --config` should show "prefix_cache + batching.strategy:auto is incompatible for quantized models" before running.

maria: agreed. I'll add a lint rule + short docs note in devex/quickstarts. PR will reference the CI job and the lint rule.

sam: PR opened: #789 (fix + test). assigning to @maria for review. I'll add the minimal reproducer under `tests/repros/quant-kv.yml`.

alex: :thumbsup: once this lands we should re-run the nightlies and bump the regression alert thresholds if it's noisy.

qa-junior: noted, will re-run and update dashboard annotations.

maria: merging after CI green. thanks folks.
